name: crime_average
description: Test 12. average = (sum of values) / count over the crime-grid tracts whose corner cell (x S, z S) has a zone type != 0, with integer sums, stored as float32; GetAverageCrime = trunc(average). S = 2: tracts (0,0), (1,0), (2,0) have corner cells (0,0), (2,0), (4,0). Values {10, 20, 0} zoned, plus an unzoned tract of 200 that is ignored -> 30 / 3 = 10.0 -> 10. With only (0,0), (2,0) zoned and values {1, 2} -> 1.5 -> GetAverageCrime 1. A zone on a non-corner cell (1,0) does not count. Unzoned city (corrected spec, 6.9 and foundations 18.1): 0/0 stores the x87 default NaN (float32 bits 0xFFC00000), which is saved as such (payload offset 65, little-endian 0000C0FF), and GetAverageCrime is the low half of _ftol's int64 indefinite = 0 (the earlier [choice] stored 0). Spec answer C1: S is the crime grid's own tract size. A tuning reload to S = 4 (message 0xC53D10AA for the tuning key) leaves the S = 2 grid alone; with only cell (2,0) zoned, tract (1,0) (value 20) is still sampled at (2,0) -> 20.0 (the tuning's S = 4 would sample (4,0), unzoned, and give NaN), and GetCrimeHotspot with hotspot (3, 4, 9) reports (9, 2 x 3, 2 x 4) = (9, 6, 8). Hand-derived.
